For the first time: a single Hindi chart that aggregates Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music and JioSaavn into one ranking. Boxoffy Music Canonical Model (BMCM) — weighted, reproducible, auditable. Because no single platform speaks for India's 600M+ music listeners.

The Cross-Platform Story
Spotify India doesn't see the full picture. Gehra Hua is #1 cross-platform (BMCM 9.4) — #1 on YouTube Music, Apple Music and JioSaavn, even though it's #3 on Spotify. And the biggest story Spotify misses: Sahiba jumps from #8 Spotify to #3 BMCM — a five-position gain driven by Apple, Amazon and Saavn dominance. Arijit Singh wins premium. Shashwat Sachdev wins D2. Independent artists win YouTube.

Boxoffy Music Desk · April 23, 2026 · Sources: Spotify India, YouTube Music India, Apple Music India, Amazon Music, JioSaavn — aggregated Apr 14–20, 2026
Boxoffy Music Canonical Model · BMCM v1.0
How 5 Platforms Become 1 Chart
No single music platform reaches India's full listening audience. Spotify dominates premium-paid (70M+ MAU). YouTube Music reaches everyone via YouTube's free tier (500M+). JioSaavn owns the Jio-bundled market (175M+). Apple and Amazon serve premium urban tiers. BMCM weights each platform by India reach × data quality, converts rank into points (11 − rank), and produces a single auditable score between 0 and 10.
YouTube Music
Weight: 0.95
India's largest audio reach via free tier. 500M+ YouTube India users. Highest weight — anything huge on YT Music is objectively huge in India.
Spotify India
Weight: 0.85
70M+ MAU. Paid-tier leader. Cleanest public data via kworb.net. Daily chart with exact stream counts. Baseline data-quality reference.
JioSaavn
Weight: 0.75
175M+ MAU. Jio-first distribution reaches Tier-2/3 India the other platforms miss. Strong in Hindi film + regional Punjabi/Haryanvi markets.
Amazon Music
Weight: 0.60
~20M India subs via Prime bundle. Growing fast. Urban-suburban mix. Lower weight — smaller reach, less transparent data.
Apple Music
Weight: 0.50
~8M India subs. Premium urban only. But this audience over-indexes on Arijit Singh and film OSTs — a critical signal cross-platform.
BMCM FORMULA

For each platform p with rank r:
  points_p = max(0, 11 − r) // #1 = 10 pts, #10 = 1 pt, unranked = 0

BMCM = Σ (points_p × weight_p) / Σ (weight_p)
  // divided by 3.65 (sum of all weights) → 0–10 scale
9.0+ DOMINANT
7.0–8.9 HIT
5.0–6.9 STRONG
3.0–4.9 SKEWED
<3.0 SINGLE-PLATFORM

The Dhurandhar 2 OST: 4-of-10 on Spotify, 3-of-10 on BMCM

Shashwat Sachdev holds 4 spots on the Spotify India top 10 (#2, #3, #6, #9). Cross-platform, that tightens to 3 in the BMCM top 10: Gehra Hua (#1), Jaiye Sajana (#5), Aari Aari (#6), Jaan Se Guzarte Hain (#8). The OST is dominant on film-music platforms (Saavn, Apple) but splits across Arijit-only tracks and ensemble tracks. Gehra Hua is the lone #1 — every OST needs one, and Shashwat-Arijit delivered.
